site_id.description: REQUIRED. Canonical site the plan is scoped to: a facility-layout Site site_code (the same identifier its SiteCapabilityChanged event publishes). A stated planning fact, never inferred from warehouse_id or location.

location.description: The ProcessCapacity location every path step is looked up under.

window_start.description: Plan window start. A registered capacity window applies when it covers [window_start, window_end).

window_end.description: Plan window end (exclusive); must be after window_start.

assigned_demand.description: OPTIONAL. Orders assigned to the window. When present (even 0) it is used exactly as stated and the plan's demand_source is "request". When omitted it defaults to the orders order-management expects at `location` in the window (GET /demand; demand_source "orders"), or the request is rejected with 422 missing-assigned-demand when there are none -- never silently 0.

units_per_order.description: WorkloadProfile factor (UNIT per ORDER); needed only if a step is measured in UNIT.

packages_per_order.description: WorkloadProfile factor (PACKAGE per ORDER); needed only if a step is measured in PACKAGE.
